design:
Child epic of the integrated petrochemical and polymer platform (bn op-9941 / see #77 programme).

**Fidelity target: Engineering model**

**The steam cracker is useless without downstream separation.**

```
cracker effluent -> quench -> compression -> acid-gas removal -> drying
                 -> cryogenic fractionation -> H2/methane | ethylene | propylene
                                             | C4 stream | pyrolysis gasoline
```

**Prefer composing existing generic units** — compressor, cooler, flash,
separator and rigorous column all exist. **Do not create one giant
`EthylenePlant` solver.**

## Two real gaps

1. **No refrigeration / cryogenic package exists.** Low-temperature
   thermodynamics for the cold box needs auditing and probably new work.
2. **Acid-gas absorption needs the `AbsorptionColumn` constructor** (P0
   blocker) — currently unreachable.

Pyrolysis gasoline feeds the BTX train, so its composition must survive as a
stream, not a label.


## Programme constraints

No monolithic plant solvers. Reuse existing reaction/thermo/separation infrastructure. Conservation preserved across every representation change. Do not push to `main`.
title: Petchem: Cracked-gas recovery train

description:
VERIFIED STILL LIVE 2026-09-03, and the bug survived a rewrite — retitled from 'scripts/gen_api_docs.py' because that script no longer exists.

scripts/gen_api_docs.py was retired 2026-08-14 (op-w44a.7) and replaced by `kovan api-docs`. The defect was ported along with the feature: crates/kovan/src/commands/api_docs.rs:104-114 runs

    cargo +nightly doc -p <pkg> --no-deps -Z unstable-options --output-format json

with NO --features and no --all-features. So any feature-gated public module is still absent from the generated crates/<crate>/docs/<crate>-api.md mirror.

Concretely, outram-blender's mirror still omits `sim` (mc-export) and `foam_mesh` (foam-mesh) — the crate's two solver bridges, i.e. its most consequential public surface. Affects every crate with opt-in bridges.

Fix: pass a per-crate feature list, or --all-features. Consider whether --all-features is safe given Android-hostile optional deps (outram-foam-basic-lib's `gpu` pulls wgpu; outram-blender's `mc-export` pulls the nuclear-data chain) — the mirror is generated on a desktop so it is probably fine, but the choice should be deliberate and documented rather than incidental.

Note the parity-gate lesson from op-w44a.7 applies in reverse here: that port DID gate parity by diffing the Python-generated api.md against the Rust one, and it passed — because both were equally wrong in this respect. A byte-identical port faithfully reproduced the bug.
title: kovan api-docs: feature-gated public modules silently missing from <crate>-api.md

description:
Maintainer request, 2026-08-14. HtgrSnapshot::default().feedwater_manual is currently false (AUTO) -- see app/mod.rs test the_gui_defaults_are_the_plant_command_defaults, which pins the opening frame to FeedwaterCommand::Auto. Change the default so the simulator opens with the feedwater station in MANUAL.

Note op-tj10 (the feedforward-controller limit-cycle bug) is open against the AUTO path -- defaulting to MANUAL sidesteps that oscillation on launch, which may be part of the motivation; do not treat this bead as a substitute fix for op-tj10.

Touch points: HtgrSnapshot::default() (app/state.rs) for the opening value, and the pinned test the_gui_defaults_are_the_plant_command_defaults (app/mod.rs) will need its AUTO assertions swapped to MANUAL -- that test exists specifically to pin the opening frame's command set, so update it deliberately rather than deleting it.
title: htgr_sim_v1: feedwater station should default to MANUAL, not AUTO
